title: The Witchcraft Scandal
synopsis: The reign of Emperor Wu of Han was marked by a notorious witchcraft scandal.

fullText.simplified:
巫蛊之祸

    如果说，要从汉朝的皇帝里选一个最有名的，那一定是汉武帝。
    这个皇帝，他有着传奇的爱情故事，手下还有两个千载难逢的大将。两位年轻又勇敢的将军——卫青、霍去病，骑着马、带着兵，四处去打仗。他们用兵如神，百战百胜，打败了匈奴和南越，占据了一块又一块的土地。汉朝的周围再也没有了威胁，汉朝的领土也越来越广阔，所拥有的土地已经超过了之前的任何一个王朝。
    汉武帝为此沾沾自喜，觉得自己是最伟大的君主。但此时的他没想到，汉朝建立以来最大的危机正在慢慢向他靠近……
    国家的领土越来越广阔，而汉武帝却慢慢变老了。不知道从什么时候开始，汉武帝就开始睡不好觉。他常常梦见许多木头人围着他打，醒来以后，他觉得自己身体越来越不好了。
    汉武帝的下人告诉他：“这意味着有人用巫术诅咒您啊！”汉武帝觉得这话有道理，愤怒之下，就四处抓人。
    有些大臣借机污蔑、陷害自己的敌人。讨厌谁，就去那个人家里偷偷放一个木头人，然后再告诉汉武帝。不知道是不是因为睡不好觉，汉武帝也没精神去分清谁对谁错，只要谁的家里有木头人，他就直接杀掉那个人。
    因为这个“巫术”，汉武帝差不多杀死了国家一半的大臣。其中，汉武帝的一个儿子企图害死太子，以便自己坐上太子的位置。所以，他告诉汉武帝，太子也用了“巫术”。
    汉武帝非常生气，叫人去查，谁知越查越乱。太子想证明自己是清白的，但别人却不停地陷害他。到最后，皇帝不相信太子，太子也不相信皇帝了。
    在这种情况下，太子不得不起兵谋反，却失败了。汉武帝怒气高涨，一狠心，杀掉了这个不听话的儿子，还杀了他的母亲，也就是皇后。
    据说，因为这个“巫术”，前前后后一共有几万人被害死，史称“巫蛊之祸”。后来又遇到了天灾，汉朝领土这么广阔，却因为常年打仗，已经没有多少粮食了。因为天灾，整个国家都陷入了危机。百姓们吃不起饭，甚至开始吃人。到了后来，百姓们再也受不了，纷纷起兵反抗，想要推翻汉武帝。
    汉武帝想要处罚这些百姓，却发现到处都有人反抗，根本管不住。他也慢慢意识到，事态严峻，都是他的错。
    最后，汉武帝不得不写下《轮台诏》，向大家道歉：对不起，我这个皇帝做得不好。我知道自己先前犯了很多错误，以后我一定会好好照顾百姓的。
    就这样，在汉武帝亲口道歉下，百姓们选择再相信皇帝一次，国家的危机慢慢平息了。此后汉武帝遵守承诺，国家也恢复了安宁。
fullText.traditional:
巫蠱之禍

    如果說，要從漢朝的皇帝裡選一個最有名的，那一定是漢武帝。
    這個皇帝，他有著傳奇的愛情故事，手下還有兩個千載難逢的大將。兩位年輕又勇敢的將軍——衛青、霍去病，騎著馬、帶著兵，四處去打仗。他們用兵如神，百戰百勝，打敗了匈奴和南越，佔據了一塊又一塊的土地。漢朝的周圍再也沒有了威脅，漢朝的領土也越來越廣闊，所擁有的土地已經超過了之前的任何一個王朝。
    漢武帝為此沾沾自喜，覺得自己是最偉大的君主。但此時的他沒想到，漢朝建立以來最大的危機正在慢慢向他靠近……
    國家的領土越來越廣闊，而漢武帝卻慢慢變老了。不知道從什麼時候開始，漢武帝就開始睡不好覺。他常常夢見許多木頭人圍著他打，醒來以後，他覺得自己身體越來越不好了。
    漢武帝的下人告訴他：“這意味著有人用巫術詛咒您啊！”漢武帝覺得這話有道理，憤怒之下，就四處抓人。
    有些大臣借機污衊、陷害自己的敵人。討厭誰，就去那個人家裡偷偷放一個木頭人，然後再告訴漢武帝。不知道是不是因為睡不好覺，漢武帝也沒精神去分清誰對誰錯，只要誰的家裡有木頭人，他就直接殺掉那個人。
    因為這個“巫術”，漢武帝差不多殺死了國家一半的大臣。其中，漢武帝的一個兒子企圖害死太子，以便自己坐上太子的位置。所以，他告訴漢武帝，太子也用了“巫術”。
    漢武帝非常生氣，叫人去查，誰知越查越亂。太子想證明自己是清白的，但別人卻不停地陷害他。到最後，皇帝不相信太子，太子也不相信皇帝了。
    在這種情況下，太子不得不起兵謀反，卻失敗了。漢武帝怒氣高漲，一狠心，殺掉了這個不聽話的兒子，還殺了他的母親，也就是皇后。
    據說，因為這個“巫術”，前前後後一共有幾萬人被害死，史稱“巫蠱之禍”。後來又遇到了天災，漢朝領土這麼廣闊，卻因為常年打仗，已經沒有多少糧食了。因為天災，整個國家都陷入了危機。百姓們吃不起飯，甚至開始吃人。到了後來，百姓們再也受不了，紛紛起兵反抗，想要推翻漢武帝。
    漢武帝想要處罰這些百姓，卻發現到處都有人反抗，根本管不住。他也慢慢意識到，事態嚴峻，都是他的錯。
    最後，漢武帝不得不寫下《輪台詔》，向大家道歉：對不起，我這個皇帝做得不好。我知道自己先前犯了很多錯誤，以後我一定會好好照顧百姓的。
    就這樣，在漢武帝親口道歉下，百姓們選擇再相信皇帝一次，國家的危機慢慢平息了。此後漢武帝遵守承諾，國家也恢復了安寧。

sentences.pinyin: hàn cháo lǐng tǔ zhè me guǎng kuò què yīn wèi cháng nián dǎ zhàng yǐ jīng méi yǒu duō shǎo liáng shi le
sentences.english: Subsequently, they were also natural disasters.

sentences.simplified: 因为天灾，整个国家都陷入了危机。
sentences.traditional: 因為天災，整個國家都陷入了危機。
sentences.pinyin: yīn wèi tiān zāi zhěng gè guó jiā dōu xiàn rù le wēi jī
sentences.english: The Han dynasty had a vast territory, but because they were constantly fighting wars, there was not much food left.

sentences.simplified: 百姓们吃不起饭，甚至开始吃人。
sentences.traditional: 百姓們吃不起飯，甚至開始吃人。
sentences.pinyin: bǎi xìng men chī bù qǐ fàn shèn zhì kāi shǐ chī rén
sentences.english: Because of natural disasters, the entire country was in crisis.

sentences.simplified: 到了后来，百姓们再也受不了，纷纷起兵反抗，想要推翻汉武帝。
sentences.traditional: 到了後來，百姓們再也受不了，紛紛起兵反抗，想要推翻漢武帝。
sentences.pinyin: dào le hòu lái bǎi xìng men zài yě shòu bù liǎo fēn fēn qǐ bīng fǎn kàng xiǎng yào tuī fān hàn wǔ dì
sentences.english: The common people could not afford to eat, and they even began to eat human flesh.
In the end, the common people could endure it no more. They rose up in rebellion, wanting to overthrow Emperor Wu.

sentences.simplified: 汉武帝想要处罚这些百姓，却发现到处都有人反抗，
sentences.traditional: 漢武帝想要處罰這些百姓，卻發現到處都有人反抗，
sentences.pinyin: hàn wǔ dì xiǎng yào chǔ fá zhè xiē bǎi xìng què fā xiàn dào chù dōu yǒu rén fǎn kàng

sentences.simplified: 根本管不住。
sentences.traditional: 根本管不住。
sentences.pinyin: gēn běn guǎn bú zhù
sentences.english: Emperor Wu wanted to punish these commoners but found that there were rebels everywhere.

sentences.simplified: 他也慢慢意识到，事态严峻，都是他的错。
sentences.traditional: 他也慢慢意識到，事態嚴峻，都是他的錯。
sentences.pinyin: tā yě màn man yì shí dào shì tài yán jùn dōu shì tā de cuò
sentences.english: There was no way they could all be contained.
He slowly realized that the situation was grave and everything was his fault.

sentences.simplified: 最后，汉武帝不得不写下《轮台诏》，向大家道歉：
sentences.traditional: 最後，漢武帝不得不寫下《輪台詔》，向大家道歉：
sentences.pinyin: zuì hòu hàn wǔ dì bù dé bù xiě xià lún tái zhào xiàng dà jiā dào qiàn

sentences.simplified: 对不起，我这个皇帝做得不好。
sentences.traditional: 對不起，我這個皇帝做得不好。
sentences.pinyin: duì bu qǐ wǒ zhè ge huáng dì zuò de bù hǎo
sentences.english: In the end, Emperor Wu had no choice but to write the “Repenting Edict of Luntai”, where he apologized to everyone:

sentences.simplified: 我知道自己先前犯了很多错误，以后我一定会好好照顾百姓的。
sentences.traditional: 我知道自己先前犯了很多錯誤，以後我一定會好好照顧百姓的。
sentences.pinyin: wǒ zhī dào zì jǐ xiān qián fàn le hěn duō cuò wù yǐ hòu wǒ yí dìng huì hǎo hǎo zhào gù bǎi xìng de
sentences.english: I am sorry, I have not done a good job as emperor.
I know that I have previously made many mistakes, and I will be sure to take good care of the common people in the future.

sentences.simplified: 就这样，在汉武帝亲口道歉下，百姓们选择再相信皇帝一次，
sentences.traditional: 就這樣，在漢武帝親口道歉下，百姓們選擇再相信皇帝一次，
sentences.pinyin: jiù zhè yàng zài hàn wǔ dì qīn kǒu dào qiàn xià bǎi xìng men xuǎn zé zài xiāng xìn huáng dì yí cì

sentences.simplified: 国家的危机慢慢平息了。
sentences.traditional: 國家的危機慢慢平息了。
sentences.pinyin: guó jiā de wēi jī màn man píng xī le
sentences.english: Just like that, with Emperor Wu’s personal apology, the common people chose to trust the emperor one more time.

sentences.simplified: 此后汉武帝遵守承诺，国家也恢复了安宁。
sentences.traditional: 此後漢武帝遵守承諾，國家也恢復了安寧。
sentences.pinyin: cǐ hòu hàn wǔ dì zūn shǒu chéng nuò guó jiā yě huī fù le ān níng
sentences.english: The crisis in the country slowly subsided.

sentence_translations: The Witchcraft Scandal
If we were to choose the most famous emperor from the Han dynasty, it would have to be Emperor Wu of Han.
There is a legendary love story about this emperor, and he also had two extremely special generals under him.
These two young and brave generals, Wei Qing and Huo Qubing, rode on horseback and led troops in battle in all directions.
They led military operations with extraordinary skill, winning every battle.
They defeated the Xiongnu and the Nanyue, occupying territory one place after another.
There were no more threats surrounding the Han dynasty, and the Han dynasty’s territory grew more and more vast,  ..
..  possessing more territory than any other dynasty in the past.
Emperor Wu was very satisfied with himself because of this and felt that he was the greatest monarch of all.
But at that time, little did he know that the greatest threat since the founding of the Han dynasty was slowly approaching him …
The country’s territory grew more and more vast, yet Emperor Wu was slowly growing old.
At some point, Emperor Wu began having trouble sleeping.
He would often dream of wooden figures surrounding him and beating him.
After waking up, he felt that his health was getting worse and worse.
Emperor Wu’s servants told him, “This means that people are using witchcraft to put a curse on you!”
Emperor Wu felt that this made a lot of sense. In his anger, he began arresting people left and right.
Some ministers took this opportunity to slander and frame their own enemies.
If they disliked someone, they would go to their house and secretly put a wooden figure there, and then go and tell Emperor Wu.
It might have been because he couldn’t sleep well, ..
.. but Emperor Wu did not have the energy to distinguish between who was right and who was wrong.
As long as there was a wooden figure in someone’s house, he would simply kill that person.
Because of this “witchcraft”, Emperor Wu killed nearly half of the country’s ministers.
Among them, one of Emperor Wu’s sons was plotting to have the crown prince killed so he could take the position of crown prince himself.
So he told Emperor Wu that the crown prince had also used “witchcraft”.
Emperor Wu was very angry and had people investigate.
Unexpectedly, the more they investigated, the more chaotic it became.
The crown prince wanted to prove that he was innocent, but other people kept making false charges against him.
In the end, the emperor did not believe the crown prince, and the crown prince did not believe the emperor.
Under these circumstances, the crown prince had no choice but to rise up and rebel. However, he failed.
Emperor Wu was so enraged that he ruthlessly killed this disobedient son, as well as the son’s mother, the empress.
It is said that because of this “witchcraft”, from beginning to end, tens of thousands of people were killed in total.
In history, this is called the “witchcraft scandal“.
Subsequently, they were also natural disasters.
The Han dynasty had a vast territory, but because they were constantly fighting wars, there was not much food left.
Because of natural disasters, the entire country was in crisis.
The common people could not afford to eat, and they even began to eat human flesh.
In the end, the common people could endure it no more. They rose up in rebellion, wanting to overthrow Emperor Wu.
Emperor Wu wanted to punish these commoners but found that there were rebels everywhere.
There was no way they could all be contained.
He slowly realized that the situation was grave and everything was his fault.
In the end, Emperor Wu had no choice but to write the “Repenting Edict of Luntai”, where he apologized to everyone:
I am sorry, I have not done a good job as emperor.
I know that I have previously made many mistakes, and I will be sure to take good care of the common people in the future.
Just like that, with Emperor Wu’s personal apology, the common people chose to trust the emperor one more time.
The crisis in the country slowly subsided.
From then on, Emperor Wu kept to his promise, and peace was restored to the country.
